observed_use.observation: Current dial/ring position was not perceptually obvious enough even though a fixed focus gate existed.
observed_use.implication: A control needs an explicit present-position witness in addition to a semantic value and a focus gate.

retained: same stable region IDs across field/list/reading projections
exported witness carries unresolved residue and next routes rather than completion theater

external_evidence.citation: Chan WH, Chan AHS. Movement compatibility for rotary control and circular display. Applied Ergonomics 34(1), 2003.
external_evidence.evidence: Hardware and simulation both showed strong clockwise↔clockwise / anticlockwise↔anticlockwise stereotypes at the 12 o'clock pointer; the authors recommend real-hardware tests when determining control-panel parameters.
external_evidence.transfer: Keep a strong fixed 12-o'clock gate, preserve conventional directional mapping, and do not treat browser simulation as proof of physical control quality.

external_evidence.citation: FAA Human Factors Considerations in the Design and Evaluation of Flight Deck Displays and Controls, §6.4.1 Rotary Controls.
external_evidence.evidence: Selected function and selector position should be clearly indicated; distinguishable detents/feedback and clear position marking are recommended; control choice should support the actual task.
external_evidence.transfer: Show the current position explicitly, show which ring is active, make snap visible, and compare AXIAL to simpler controls for the same task.

external_evidence.citation: Shneiderman B. The future of interactive systems and the emergence of direct manipulation. Behaviour & Information Technology 1(3), 1982/83.
external_evidence.evidence: Direct manipulation emphasizes visible objects, rapid incremental reversible actions, and physical action rather than complex syntax.
external_evidence.transfer: Keep selection visible during motion, make each notch incremental/reversible, and avoid modal command syntax for ordinary navigation.

external_evidence.citation: Buxton W. A Three-State Model of Graphical Input. INTERACT 1990.
external_evidence.evidence: Input-device capabilities should be matched to the demands of the interaction transaction.
external_evidence.transfer: Separate tracking/positioning, engaged manipulation, and committed action; do not force one gesture to carry every transaction state.

external_evidence.citation: Fitzmaurice GW, Ishii H, Buxton WAS. Bricks: laying the foundations for graspable user interfaces. CHI 1995.
external_evidence.evidence: Physical handles can be tightly coupled to virtual objects or parameters so the grasped object itself carries manipulation semantics.
external_evidence.transfer: A later physical AXIAL body must preserve readable state and tight object↔control coupling; a cylinder is optional unless it earns that coupling.

external_evidence.citation: Jacob RJK et al. Reality-Based Interaction: A Framework for Post-WIMP Interfaces. CHI 2008.
external_evidence.evidence: Reality-based interaction offers a framework for analyzing post-WIMP techniques by how they leverage familiar real-world knowledge while trading against expressive power and other qualities.
external_evidence.transfer: Prefer mappings that reuse learned spatial/motor expectations; add abstraction only when it buys real expressive power.

external_evidence.citation: Kasuga S et al. Integration of proprioceptive and visual feedback during online control of reaching. Journal of Neurophysiology 127(2), 2022.
external_evidence.evidence: Vision and proprioception both contribute to online control; the study characterizes vision as more accurate and proprioception as faster, with important effects when the two become misaligned.
external_evidence.transfer: Keep visual position feedback tightly synchronized with manipulation; later physical tests must check visual↔felt alignment rather than assuming one modality can substitute for the other.

design_rules_now: CURRENT POSITION MUST BE VISIBLE WITHOUT READING THE DATA MODEL.
ACTIVE RING MUST BE DISTINGUISHABLE FROM OTHER RINGS.
FIXED GATE AND MOVING POSITION WITNESS ARE DIFFERENT SIGNALS.
VALUE + ORDINAL POSITION + SUPPORT ARE DIFFERENT READINGS; DO NOT COLLAPSE THEM.
CLOCKWISE / FORWARD MAPPINGS SHOULD FOLLOW ESTABLISHED EXPECTATIONS UNLESS A TASK-SPECIFIC TEST JUSTIFIES OTHERWISE.
SNAP / DETENT IS FEEDBACK, NOT DECORATION.
DEAD STATES MAY REMAIN INSPECTABLE; THE SYSTEM MUST NOT SILENTLY MOVE THE USER.
PLAIN LIST / SEARCH REMAINS THE CONTROL CONDITION.
BROWSER SUCCESS IS NOT PHYSICAL-HARDWARE EVIDENCE.
DEEP FOCUS MUST RETAIN AN OVERVIEW POSITION WITNESS.
OVERVIEW AND DETAIL MUST ADDRESS THE SAME STATE, NOT DUPLICATE STATE.
ENGINEERING TRACE MUST BE AVAILABLE WITHOUT TAXING THE PRIMARY SURFACE.
LOCAL STUDY MAY PROPOSE ADAPTATION; IT MAY NOT SILENTLY SELF-MODIFY THE INTERFACE.
measures_for_observed_use: time to reacquire current ring/value after interruption
RING vs STRIP preference by task
visual-position / physical-position mismatch in later hardware

centralization.rule: Survivor/support law is source-neutral and shared by FIELD and AXIAL. AXIAL-only ordinal/angle presentation remains under AXIAL. STATE APERTURE transaction/actuation semantics are not part of Constraint Surface.
centralization.component_path: Promote a UI component only when a third consumer needs the same interaction surface; source adapters and consequence semantics stay outside the kernel.
centralization.dat_gui_path: No dat.GUI/lil-gui/tweakpane dependency is currently required. If added later, use it only as a developer/debug inspector, never as the primary human interface.

breakthrough_method.hypothesis: The strongest recent leaps were not caused by images alone. They occurred when a concrete visual/artifact reference acted as a retrieval anchor, exact donor behavior was recovered, a present-use failure was observed, and only one mechanism was transferred into a working surface.
breakthrough_method.anti_pattern: Moodboard → metaphor → new interface with no recovered mechanism or task comparison.

observed: ring/notch or drag events by dimension
live_study.adaptation_policy: The inspector may surface a candidate such as one ring dominating use or repeated dead alignments. It never automatically reorders, remaps or changes authority. Any adaptation must be an explicit new transfer with receipt.

constraint_surface_extraction.preserved_boundary: /foundry/axial/lab-0.5.1.html retains STATE APERTURE transform/TEST/ARM/RUN semantics outside the kernel.
constraint_surface_extraction.invariant: records × dimensions × selection → survivors + candidate support; expose possibility, never choose or act.
